Issue #83: Implement lc.py - line count CLI tool

<!-- atoma:parent=#82 -->
Implement a simple line count CLI tool in `lc.py` using only Python stdlib.

## Requirements
- Accept file path(s) as command-line arguments
- Count lines in each file (using newline character)
- Support reading from stdin when no file arguments provided
- Support `-l` flag for counting lines only (default behavior)
- Display count and filename for each file
- If multiple files, show total at the bottom
- Handle errors gracefully (file not found, etc.)
- Use only Python standard library (no external dependencies)

## Success Criteria
- `python lc.py <file>` prints line count and filename
- `cat <file> | python lc.py` reads from stdin
- `python lc.py <file1> <file2>` shows counts per file plus total
- `python lc.py -l <file>` works (compatible with wc -l style)
- All error conditions handled gracefully
